description: Provenance for every vendored file in this plugin: source repo, source path, commit SHA, vendoring date, local divergence, and sha256. sampletypes_db.json already existed in three copies at three vintages with no record of which was authoritative; this file exists so that never happens again. Managed context files are updated by scripts/refresh_context.py --write; vendored report assets are recorded by hand when added.

context/assays_db.json.local_divergence: none; Generated upstream by scripts/context_gen.py --emit exports from the curated context/assays.json (commit 1641ea0c, 2026-09-21): one row per internal assay.

context/neo4j_assay-sample-conn.json.local_divergence: none; Captured upstream by scripts/graph_schema_fallback.py (commit 8c6e0c70, 2026-09-24) from the LOCAL graph at schema 1.2, not production; see VINTAGE.json.

context/neo4j_schema.json.local_divergence: none; Captured upstream by scripts/graph_schema_fallback.py (commit 8c6e0c70, 2026-09-24) from the LOCAL graph at schema 1.2, not production; see VINTAGE.json.

context/projects_db.json.local_divergence: none; Generated upstream by scripts/context_gen.py --emit exports from the curated context/projects.json (last changed e10ad724, 2026-09-24). Rows carry no `labs` key; the NExtSEEK runtime adds those.

context/report_templates/GEO-updated.jso.local_divergence: none; byte-identical to dmac-assistant's tools/hibayes/resources/GEO-updated.json (sha256 4ce6bc4c2193951ab3e594a48feea663cba6d5d44bfa3b10932459e26048578f), so report-spec open question 1 (which GEO-updated.json is authoritative) is moot -- the choice is arbitrary. Supersedes chat_nextseek geo.json (adds the SRA-derived controlled vocabulary), which was NOT vendored.

context/report_templates/SRA.json.local_divergence: none; two row-bearing sections -- `libraries` feeds SRA_metadata.xlsx, `biosamples` feeds SRA_biosample.xlsx.

context/report_templates/pride.json.local_divergence: none; NOT a spreadsheet -- declares a tab-delimited ProteomeXchange Submission Summary File (submission.px) with MTD/FMH/FME/SMH/SME/COM line prefixes, not an xlsx. No pride.xlsx is vendored.

context/sampletypes_db.json.local_divergence: none; Generated upstream by scripts/context_gen.py --emit exports from the curated context/sample_types.json (commit 1641ea0c, 2026-09-21).

scripts/report/validate_artifact.py.local_divergence: SUBSET plus extension. Upstream is 897 lines and imports tools.hibayes.enums and tools.hibayes.exporter; most of it is a 29-column evidence-CSV harness (run_stage_a, CSV_HEADER_29, rebase_artifact_path, classify_artifact_kind, the nf-core and SVG validators) that this plugin has no use for. Taken: ArtifactStatus, ValidatorResult, the GEO two-part required-field check, and the single-pass read-only-workbook discipline. Added: SRA (libraries and biosamples sections) and PRIDE (tab-delimited px, not xlsx), plus a DISPOSITION map onto CLEAN/SOFT_FLAG/HARD_REJECT. The GEO reader also auto-locates the *library name header row instead of assuming row 1: the real GEO Metadata sheet is a vertical multi-section form (a # comment on row 1, a STUDY block, then the SAMPLES header partway down, a blank gap, then PROTOCOLS), so the header is not at row 1 and a row-0 assumption HARD_REJECTs a valid artifact.
